name: init
js: (() => { const d = document.getElementById('setupDialog'); if (d && d.open) d.close(); window.GMMC.newMap('template'); const m = window.GMMC.getMap(); window.__orig = m.lines.map((l) => ({ name: l.name, stops: new Set(l.path.filter((r) => r[0] !== '@')).size, peak: l.freq && l.freq.peak, mid: l.freq && (l.freq.midday || l.freq.offpeak) })); return { lines: m.lines.length, stations: Object.keys(m.stations).length }; })()

name: open
js: (async () => { const blob = await window.GMMCGtfsExport.build(); window.__file = new File([blob], 'gtha-export.zip', { type: 'application/zip' }); window.GMMCGtfs.open(window.__file); const t0 = performance.now(); while (document.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-row').length === 0 && performance.now() - t0 < 60000) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-row')]; return { title: document.getElementById('gtfsTitle').textContent, rows: rows.length, file: document.getElementById('gtfsFile').textContent, stats: ['R', 'S', 'D'].map((k) => document.getElementById('gtfsStat' + k).textContent), chips: [...document.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-chip')].map((c) => c.textContent.trim()), badges: rows.slice(0, 4).map((r) => { const n = r.querySelector('.gtfs-num'); return [n.textContent, n.style.background, n.style.color]; }), goDisabled: document.getElementById('gtfsGo').disabled, dlgW: document.getElementById('gtfsDialog').getBoundingClientRect().width, previewEmptyShown: !document.getElementById('gtfsPvEmpty').hidden }; })()

name: select
js: (async () => { const boxes = [...document.querySelectorAll('input[data-id]')].slice(0, 3); const before = document.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-pr .ln').length; boxes.forEach((b) => b.click()); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const sel = (id) => document.getElementById(id).textContent; const one = document.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-pr .ln').length; boxes[2].click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const two = document.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-pr .ln').length; boxes[2].click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); return { pathsBefore: before, pathsThree: one, pathsAfterUncheck: two, pathsBack: document.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-pr .ln').length, adds: { routes: sel('gtfsAddR'), newStops: sel('gtfsAddN'), merged: sel('gtfsAddM') }, go: document.getElementById('gtfsGo').textContent.trim(), checkedAria: boxes.map((b) => b.getAttribute('aria-label')), rowTint: getComputedStyle(boxes[0].closest('.gtfs-row')).backgroundColor, previewEmptyShown: !document.getElementById('gtfsPvEmpty').hidden, svgBox: (() => { const b = document.getElementById('gtfsSvg').getBBox(); const p = document.getElementById('gtfsPreview').getBoundingClientRect(); return { w: Math.round(b.width), h: Math.round(b.height), boxW: Math.round(p.width), boxH: Math.round(p.height) }; })() }; })()

name: tab-order
js: (() => { const d = document.getElementById('gtfsDialog'); const f = [...d.querySelectorAll('button, input, [tabindex]')].filter((e) => !e.disabled && e.tabIndex >= 0 && e.offsetParent !== null); const names = f.map((e) => e.id || e.className.split(' ')[0] + (e.dataset.id ? ':' + e.dataset.id : '')); return { count: f.length, first: names.slice(0, 7), last: names.slice(-4), overflowX: document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth, dlgOverflowX: d.scrollWidth > d.clientWidth }; })()

name: search
js: (() => { const q = document.getElementById('gtfsQuery'); const all = document.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-row').length; q.value = 'zzzz-nothing'; q.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); const none = document.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-row').length; const msg = document.getElementById('gtfsList').textContent.trim(); const first = window.__first = document.querySelector('.gtfs-row .gtfs-name'); q.value = ''; q.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); const chips = [...document.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-chip')]; const filt = chips.length > 2 ? (chips[1].click(), document.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-row').length) : -1; document.querySelector('.gtfs-chip[data-type=all]').click(); return { all, none, msg, filteredByFirstType: filt, allAgain: document.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-row').length, checkedKept: document.querySelectorAll('input[data-id]:checked').length }; })()

name: yue
js: (async () => { document.documentElement.dataset.theme = 'light'; const s = window.GMMC.getSettings(); s.lang = 'yue'; window.GMMC.saveSettings(); window.GMMC.applyI18n(); document.getElementById('gtfsDialog').close(); window.GMMCGtfs.open(window.__file); const t0 = performance.now(); while (document.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-row').length === 0 && performance.now() - t0 < 60000) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); [...document.querySelectorAll('input[data-id]')].slice(0, 3).forEach((b) => b.click()); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const d = document.getElementById('gtfsDialog'); return { title: document.getElementById('gtfsTitle').textContent, sub: document.getElementById('gtfsSub').textContent, search: document.getElementById('gtfsQuery').placeholder, change: document.getElementById('gtfsChange').textContent, chips: [...document.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-chip')].map((c) => c.textContent.trim()), go: document.getElementById('gtfsGo').textContent.trim(), cancel: document.getElementById('gtfsCancel').textContent, adds: [...d.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-adds small, .gtfs-adds h3, .gtfs-addnote')].map((e) => e.textContent), hw: (d.querySelector('.gtfs-hw small') || {}).textContent, dates: document.getElementById('gtfsStatD').textContent }; })()

name: enter-imports
js: (async () => { const s = window.GMMC.getSettings(); s.lang = 'en'; window.GMMC.saveSettings(); window.GMMC.applyI18n(); const before = window.GMMC.getMap().lines.length; const cb = document.querySelector('input[data-id]'); cb.focus(); cb.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1200)); return { linesBefore: before, linesAfter: window.GMMC.getMap().lines.length, dialogOpen: document.getElementById('gtfsDialog').open }; })()

name: escape-closes
js: (async () => { window.GMMCGtfs.open(window.__file); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const wasOpen = document.getElementById('gtfsDialog').open; document.getElementById('gtfsDialog').dispatchEvent(new Event('cancel', { cancelable: false })); document.getElementById('gtfsDialog').close(); return { wasOpen, nowOpen: document.getElementById('gtfsDialog').open }; })()

name: import-all-blank
js: (async () => { window.GMMC.newMap('blank'); window.GMMCGtfs.open(window.__file); const t0 = performance.now(); while (document.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-row').length === 0 && performance.now() - t0 < 60000) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const boxes = [...document.querySelectorAll('input[data-id]')]; boxes.forEach((b) => { b.checked = true; b.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }); const plan = { routes: document.getElementById('gtfsAddR').textContent, newStops: document.getElementById('gtfsAddN').textContent, merged: document.getElementById('gtfsAddM').textContent }; document.getElementById('gtfsGo').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const m = window.GMMC.getMap(); const got = m.lines.map((l) => ({ name: l.name.trim(), stops: l.path.length, peak: l.freq.peak, mid: l.freq.offpeak })); const cmp = window.__orig.map((o0) => { const none = !o0.peak && !o0.mid, o = none ? Object.assign({}, o0, { peak: 10, mid: 10 }) : o0; const g = got.find((x) => x.name === o.name); return g ? { name: o.name, stopsOk: g.stops === o.stops, peakOk: g.peak === o.peak, midOk: g.mid === o.mid } : { name: o.name, missing: true }; }); return { checkboxes: boxes.length, plan, importedLines: m.lines.length, originalLines: window.__orig.length, stations: Object.keys(m.stations).length, mismatches: cmp.filter((c) => c.missing || !c.stopsOk || !c.peakOk || !c.midOk).length, colours: m.lines.slice(0, 4).map((l) => l.color) }; })()

name: reimport-merge
js: (async () => { window.GMMCGtfs.open(window.__file); const t0 = performance.now(); while (document.querySelectorAll('.gtfs-row').length === 0 && performance.now() - t0 < 60000) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const cb = document.querySelector('input[data-id]'); cb.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const plan = { newStops: document.getElementById('gtfsAddN').textContent, merged: document.getElementById('gtfsAddM').textContent }; const before = Object.keys(window.GMMC.getMap().stations).length; document.getElementById('gtfsGo').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 800)); return { plan, before, after: Object.keys(window.GMMC.getMap().stations).length }; })()
